data_pipeline.trigger_chain: 1. EventBridge schedules (UTC, MON-FRI): 21:38 bd-unrealized-pipeline-trigger -> bd-unrealized-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-allocations EC2 (snapshot) 21:45 bd-realized-pipeline-trigger -> bd-realized-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-allocations EC2 (incremental) 21:53 bd-transaction-pipeline-trigger -> bd-transactions-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-transactions EC2 22:00 bd-allocation-pipeline-trigger -> bd-allocation-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-allocations EC2 22:10 bd-asset-dim-pipeline-trigger -> bd-asset-dim-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-assets EC2 (BDPL_ASTDIM.W6) 22:15 bd-fees-pipeline-trigger -> bd-fees-trigger -> SSM doc on bd-fees EC2 (silver/fees write) 22:30 bd-allocation-file-check-daily -> bd-allocation-file-checker 23:00 bd-gold-nightly-fallback (MON-SAT) -> bd-gold-trigger (safety net) 2. Allocation files arrive at s3://opal-data-bd/forwardfill_v2/allocations/*.xlsx -> bd-allocation-processor (S3 trigger; processes silver/, then invokes bd-price-update Lambda async) 3. Daily price parquet at s3://opal-data-bd/silver/prices/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet -> bd-gold-trigger (S3 trigger; starts bd-gold-layer-runner EC2) 4. Gold runner (bd-gold-layer-runner, c6i.16xlarge, S3-pull from opal-data-bd/code/gold/) -> writes opal-data-bd/gold/* parquets and platinum/* JSON artifacts -> writes opal-data-bd/gold/pipeline-complete.json sentinel 5. Sentinel s3://opal-data-bd/gold/pipeline-complete*.json -> bd-portal-publisher (S3 trigger; primary) -> async invokes bd-portal-advisor-publisher (Lambda-to-Lambda fan-out) -> async invokes bd-capture-output-versions at end (writes snapshots/manifests/) 6. Daily 04:00 UTC bd-canonical-prices-daily -> bd-gold-trigger (mode=incremental) -> gold_dispatch.sh runs S_00 build_canonical_prices_v2.py before freshness gate -> on weekdays full A/B/C/D chain runs; on weekends silver-prep only 7. Daily 14:00 UTC historical-prices-daily -> historical-prices-scheduler -> spawns historical-prices-fetcher EC2 (yfinance) -> opal-data-bd/silver/historical_prices.parquet

known_gotchas.gotcha: bd-portal-advisor-publisher and bd-capture-output-versions are NOT S3-triggered. They are invoked Lambda-to-Lambda by bd-portal-publisher. Do not add S3 notification rules for either function -- S3 disallows duplicate prefix+suffix rules on the same bucket+event.

bd-gold-layer-runner (i-01003b035d2988dfb) is EVENTBRIDGE-ONLY. Never start, stop, or run SSM commands against it manually -- only the bd-gold-trigger Lambda invoked by an EventBridge rule may touch it. Manual / QA gold runs go to bd-gold-qa-runner (i-0090b823a4a0997e3). Source: EC2_MANIFEST.json _access_policy.

opal-portal-data-proxy is NOT in any ClientPlatform-owned module. It lives in infra/aws/terraform/market-overview/lambdas.tf and is owned by 0.5.0_AE_OpalETL. ClientPlatform DT must coordinate before any handler change -- this is the primary AUM data path for ModelPortfolios.

Lambda@Edge functions (5 in portal-auth) have `lifecycle.ignore_changes = [qualified_arn, source_code_hash]`. Updates require explicit publish=true and CloudFront association version bump. Plan diffs may look noisy; check actual function $LATEST + version_id.
